description: Physical pointer dwell over the English candidate opened the full definition without committing; nih composition remained visible.
A normal mouse click on the English display row committed Chinese 你好 to the actual VS Code document.
Three sequential native key calls (105/78/79 ms) preserved nih and the matching candidate after popup creation; no claim of frame-by-frame animation timing.
F2 toggled the full definition, kept nih composition and did not submit text.
Ctrl+Shift+Enter explicitly committed hello after 你好; the actual VS Code document became 你好hello.
Repeating the explicit English shortcut did not append a second hello or alter the document.
VS Code had an active nih composition and a hello candidate before switching applications.
Returning from VS Code showed the project Notepad document empty (0 characters); the earlier n composition and candidate were cleared.
The English shortcut in Notepad after switching from a live VS Code candidate inserted no old English text; document remained empty.
After switching applications, a fresh nih composition followed by Space committed 你好 normally.
Returning from Notepad cleared the prior nih composition; VS Code contained only the committed 你好hello.
Before stopping the isolated service, VS Code had nih composition plus a full hello definition.

On resuming and activating the project VS Code window, only committed 你好hello was visible; the older composition was gone. Intervening focus changes prevent attributing this alone to the earlier service stop.
With project VS Code continuously foreground, nih composition and full hello definition were visible immediately before stopping this isolated service.
Stopping the isolated service while VS Code stayed foreground automatically removed the nih composition, candidate window and full definition; committed 你好hello remained.
Ctrl+Shift+Enter after disconnection did not submit the former hello candidate or alter the document.
Fresh native n/i/h key input automatically reconnected and displayed the correct 你好 / hello candidate.
Space after automatic reconnection committed a new 你好; VS Code now contained 你好hello你好.
Windows Display Settings showed 150% (recommended), 2560 x 1600 landscape. The scale will be restored after the check.
Windows Display Settings confirmed 125% at unchanged 2560 x 1600 resolution.
At actual Windows 125% scaling, nih produced the full candidate bar in VS Code, with readable 你好 / hello and all toolbar controls visible.
At 125% scaling, F2 opened the separate full definition without clipping the candidate bar or composing text.
At 125% scaling, a normal click on the first Chinese candidate committed 你好 and closed both popups; hit testing matched the displayed row.
Windows Display Settings confirmed original 150% (recommended), 2560 x 1600 landscape restored after the 125% test.
The ni candidate list was visibly on its second page (starting with 逆) before the rapid page-return/input sequence.

PageUp immediately followed by native h input preserved the nih composition and refreshed the first candidate to 你好 / hello; no stale second-page candidate or unintended commit remained. Calls began 122.6 ms apart; this is not frame-by-frame animation timing.
With the caret near the right edge at actual 150% scaling, the candidate bar shifted left and all candidates and toolbar controls remained visible.
Near the right/lower edge at 150%, F2 placed the full definition above the candidate bar, wholly visible without covering the composition.
Scrolling the live composition to the bottom edge kept nih uncommitted and positioned the candidate bar above the caret, with every control inside the screen.
At the bottom edge, the full definition appeared above the upward-shifted candidate bar; the nih composition stayed visible below both popups.
A normal click on the repositioned first candidate committed 你好 exactly once and dismissed both popups; hit testing matched the displayed position.
